findings.issue: Glob includes cross-owner peer directed evidence; pulse and TDM reference each other, causing source-binding false failure.
findings.recommendation: Use explicit per-owner report names or exclude only explicitly enumerated cross-owner reports; require owner reports and fail wrong bindings.
findings.resolution: Latest utility enumerates mandatory owner suite filenames per group, excludes named foreign reviews, and requires all owner reports.

findings.issue: len(evidence)>=4 includes synthesis; only3functional evidence reports could satisfy intended4.
findings.recommendation: Require >=4 owner functional evidence separately plus synthesis; explicit required suite list is stronger.
findings.resolution: Latest utility enumerates mandatory owner suite filenames per group, excludes named foreign reviews, and requires all owner reports.

findings.issue: No explicit required module/profile sets: synthesis profiles may be empty or omit TDM RX/TX while audit passes.
findings.recommendation: Require nonempty profiles and required module set {tdm_audio_rx,tdm_audio_tx,pulse_measurement,onewire_rom_search}; enforce meaningful default/max profiles.
findings.resolution: Latest audit enforces exact module set and >=3profiles/module, mandatory64hex log SHA, explicit Gowin ALU54D/PADD9/PADD18 DSP census excluded from LUT sum; independent negative mutation tests reject missing coverage/log SHA.

findings.issue: DSP census only MULT/DSP misses Gowin ALU54D/PADD9/PADD18 primitive families; startswith ALU would count ALU54D as LUT.
findings.recommendation: Explicit DSP primitive census and unsupported-cell rejection; current12profiles have no such DSP cells so current counts remain valid.
findings.resolution: Latest audit enforces exact module set and >=3profiles/module, mandatory64hex log SHA, explicit Gowin ALU54D/PADD9/PADD18 DSP census excluded from LUT sum; independent negative mutation tests reject missing coverage/log SHA.

findings.issue: report_sha256 optional permits matching any same-cell log without binding exact synthesis log provenance.
findings.recommendation: Require report_sha256 for every profile; present in all current profiles.
findings.resolution: Latest audit enforces exact module set and >=3profiles/module, mandatory64hex log SHA, explicit Gowin ALU54D/PADD9/PADD18 DSP census excluded from LUT sum; independent negative mutation tests reject missing coverage/log SHA.

findings.issue: finalize uses all() on results/integrations without nonempty expected-IP coverage, potentially accepting missing work if external checkpoint checks weaken.
findings.recommendation: Assert expected four-IP case coverage and meaningful integration counts in this audit or bind explicit external checks.
findings.note: External checkpoint/ancestry and regression coverage checks remain required; resource utility does not substitute functional regression.
